component.name: Ignis
component.summary: Install and set up apps for Bazzite

description.p: Ignis is a one-stop installer for Bazzite. It detects your graphics hardware and offers a curated list of gaming, emulation, media and streaming applications that can each be installed with a single click, without ever opening a terminal.

Ignis installs software on your behalf. To do that it runs standard package commands on the host system — such as installing Flatpaks from Flathub or running Bazzite's own setup recipes — and it always shows you the exact command it is about to run, streams the live output, and keeps a full log you can read afterwards.

ul.li: GitHub releases, with automatic update checks
Vetted configuration scripts bundled with Ignis
Browse a curated catalog of gaming, emulation, media, streaming and system apps.
Install from Flathub, Bazzite's own setup recipes, GitHub releases, or bundled setup scripts.
See the exact command before it runs, watch its output live, and keep a full log.
Check for and apply updates to apps installed from GitHub.
Graphics card detection, so apps meant for other hardware are marked.
